   128: //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   129: // Rejects any D3D9 devices that aren't acceptable to the app by returning false
   130: //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   131: bool CALLBACK IsDeviceAcceptable( D3DCAPS9* pCaps, D3DFORMAT AdapterFormat,
   132:                                   D3DFORMAT BackBufferFormat, bool bWindowed, void* pUserContext )
   133: {
   134:     // No fallback, so need ps2.0
   135:     if( pCaps->PixelShaderVersion < D3DPS_VERSION( 2, 0 ) )
   136:         return false;
   137: 
   138:     // Skip backbuffer formats that don't support alpha blending
   139:     IDirect3D9* pD3D = DXUTGetD3D9Object();
   140:     if( FAILED( pD3D->CheckDeviceFormat( pCaps->AdapterOrdinal, pCaps->DeviceType,
   141:                                          AdapterFormat, D3DUSAGE_QUERY_POSTPIXELSHADER_BLENDING,
   142:                                          D3DRTYPE_TEXTURE, BackBufferFormat ) ) )
   143:         return false;
   144: 
   145:     return true;
   146: }
